narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On November 14, 2024, at approximately 0300 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stopped a pickup truck with four occupants on M-50 near Dundee, Michigan, at the request of the Monroe County Sheriff's Office. All four occupants stated that they are citizens of Mexico without immigration documents.
RECORD CHECKS:
Record checks on the four occupants showed that one of them had been ordered removed by an immigration judge in 2011; the remaining three had no record. The results did not identify which occupant the order concerns.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is being presented for prosecution under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal.
DISPOSITION:
All four occupants were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station.
